mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you must craft giant prompts with design context to unlock superintelligent models. Designers should build own tools.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 不会变得更聪明，你必须用包含设计上下文的巨型提示词来解锁超级智能模型。设计师应自建工具。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect, focus on one problem, and model success of others.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，专注一个问题，并模仿他人的成功。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought and RLHF were key to GPT-4; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链和 RLHF 是 GPT-4 成功的关键；扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't yield AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed for continual learning and AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 成为瓶颈；需要新架构和更好的学习算法以实现持续学习和 AGI。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but current models plateau in diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据模拟人类行为，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一步是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是分布式专业化智能体社会；对齐它们需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类价值和偏见，而非超级理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven progress for 13-14 years; transformers and self-supervised learning are key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动进步达 13-14 年，Transformer 和自监督学习是核心。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测；推理已占数据中心功耗 90%。

jeffdean.en: AI is at junior-engineer level; the scarce skill is taste, not coding; inference is the bottleneck, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师水平，稀缺技能是品味而非编码；推理而非训练才是瓶颈。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; hybrid human-AI systems create value.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，人机混合系统能创造更多价值。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data has limits; US and China labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调专用数据的后训练是关键，合成数据有局限，并认为中美实验室在研究上无差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; BCI needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我警示 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，并需要脑机接口保持相关性。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence near; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体已实际应用，超级智能临近，且开源需谨慎。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key; becoming multiplanetary is existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年：火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维是关键；成为多星球物种是存在性保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient; kindness can break violence cycles.
elon.zh: 2023 年：AI 安全需要监管和追求真理；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 计算效率高；善意能打破暴力循环。

elon.en: Neuralink first implant; AI risk is lying, not superintelligence; population decline is civilization's biggest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年：Neuralink 首次植入；AI 风险在于撒谎而非超级智能；人口下降是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: AI superintelligence imminent; truth-seeking is core; humanoid robots and Starship reusability will transform economy.
elon.zh: 2025 年：AI 超级智能临近；追求真理是核心；人形机器人和 Starship 可重复使用将变革经济。

elon.en: AI and robotics drive abundance; space-based AI compute; universal high income via deflation; AI surpasses humans by 2030.
elon.zh: 2026 年：AI 和机器人推动富足；太空 AI 算力；通过通缩实现普遍高收入；AI 在 2030 年前超越人类。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型现在包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Omni 是一个统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人应专注于机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应从人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source nuance.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力是最宝贵的资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI 成为方向；机器人技术不可或缺；AI 让创业公司蓬勃发展。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，AI 应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是 AI 的下一个前沿，使机器能理解并与 3D 世界交互；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象和情商；世界模型推动具身 AI 发展。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and learning ability matter more than degrees.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，人类能动性和学习能力比学位更重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data and reliable evaluation; robots need specialization.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和可靠评估；机器人需专业化。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity per engineer up 200% with Claude Code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者。使用 Claude Code 后人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; safety studied via early release. Generalists valued over specialists.
boris.zh: AI 编写了 Anthropic 80% 的代码；通过早期发布研究安全性。通才比专才更受重视。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; code volume up 250%. Non-engineers adopt AI heavily.
boris.zh: 具备工具使用的智能体驱动指数级增长；代码量提升 250%。非工程师大量采用 AI。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops are next abstraction after agents.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全、创意。循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象层。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction better for frontier models. Product overhang exists.
boris.zh: 具备记忆和自主性的主动 AI；对前沿模型而言，更少的指令更好。产品过剩存在。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via effort parameter: Opus-level quality at fraction of cost, challenging cost-scaling assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 通过努力参数实现智能缩放：以更低成本获得 Opus 级质量，挑战成本随规模增长的假设。

diannepenn.en: Alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking, not just safety.
diannepenn.zh: 对齐不仅关乎安全，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use evolves from constrained to open-ended agents; scaffolds become intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境演进到开放式智能体；脚手架成为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates Claude; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption, evals replace PRDs.
diannepenn.zh: 编程能力成为 Claude 的差异化优势；Claude Code 和 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代产品需求文档。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized.
diannepenn.zh: 安全与对齐使 Claude 更有用，因为它能提出异议；AI 写作生硬但优先级低于智能体能力。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或增长两倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; more compute is used for safety and reflection.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 进展是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；更多算力用于安全、反思和真实性。

jensen.en: Scaling laws expanded from pre-training and post-training to inference-time and agentic scaling, each requiring 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，缩放定律从预训练和后训练扩展到推理时和智能体式缩放，每一步都需要 100 倍算力。

jensen.en: AI is agentic, doing useful work; future internet will be dominated by billions of AI agents generating intelligence.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已进入智能体时代，能完成有用工作；未来互联网将由数十亿 AI 智能体主导，持续生成智能。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever, as tasks are automated.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋坚持 AI 创造而非消灭工作；放射科医生和程序员的需求反而增加，因为任务被自动化。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding, and founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于误解，创始人应专注产品而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶核心价值是挽救生命；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更可扩展；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 应用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场，速度将催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes the dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips offering 2500x speedup over GPUs due to SRAM.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标，晶圆级芯片因 SRAM 比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train without it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河削弱，领先模型训练不再依赖，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; space data centers are over 5 years away.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；太空数据中心需 5 年以上。

feldman.en: Hardware-software co-design is essential; hardcoding architectures is a mistake; accelerate sparse linear algebra.
feldman.zh: 软硬件协同设计至关重要；硬编码架构是错误；应加速稀疏线性代数。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses; new abilities emerge spiky, requiring evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具更聪明，新能力以非直观方式涌现，需不断更新脚手架。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferred. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能是反模式，图结构上下文搜索更优；编码不需要超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts; shorter principles beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示，短原则优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias, improve quality. Agents as employees metaphor limited due to uneven memory.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见、提升质量；智能体作为员工隐喻有局限，因其记忆不均。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出 LLM 是“合理性引擎”而非“真相引擎”，可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，专业模型或优于通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索，认为代理指标误导，应关注真实任务。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks excel in out-of-distribution generalization with fewer parameters, scaling via closed-form.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出液态神经网络以更少参数实现优越的分布外泛化，并通过闭式解扩展规模。

hasani.en: Attention remains vital for large models; simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为注意力机制对大型模型仍关键，而小型专用模型可用简单门控卷积。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, targeting actions not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张 AI 监管应适应性强，针对行为而非能力，避免被大型实验室俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; small models deliver private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，强调开放权重模型促进企业定制与数据主权，小型模型提供私有端侧智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UI is poor; wrapped apps drive adoption.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人界面不佳；封装应用推动采用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect, value across stack.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，价值分布在整个技术栈。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining; coding is clear fit, other domains uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用是长期的工作流程重塑；编程是明确契合点，其他领域不确定。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is key.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，预测推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；强调软硬件协同设计的关键性。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost-performance; memory shortage due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出 AI 模型每年成本性能提升约 60 倍；内存短缺源于推理（reasoning）和智能体式（agentic）工作负载。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality are core; glasses will ground us in reality.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调真实连接与阅后即焚是核心，眼镜将让我们扎根现实。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and kindness drive innovation; copying validates, but ecosystems beat features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为学习速度和善意驱动创新；抄袭是验证，但生态胜过功能。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value to creativity; authentic content remains prized.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AI 加速原型制作，价值转向创意；真实内容仍受珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest; software is no moat; hardware and ecosystems are durable.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，分发最难；软件非护城河；硬件和生态才持久。

evanspiegel.en: Computing must become more human; transparency and admitting mistakes speed learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，计算应更人性化；透明和认错加速学习。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来的 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法达到的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; facts and skills are inseparable, enabling deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；事实与技能不可分割，能实现更深的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression (like pre-training) is needed, not just RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级别的万亿 token；需要基于训练的压缩（如预训练），而非仅靠 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, users own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——token 越多准确率越低；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; next paradigm requires doing more with less, combining routing with a trusted sidekick model.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，将路由与可信的“副手”模型结合。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots, not just language models; current LLMs are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要物理机器人，而不仅仅是语言模型；当前的 LLM 远未达到 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 进展并未加速；我们距离超人 AI 的程度与 1970 年代相当。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统将对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone; open-source competition will erode moats and cause a crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 大规模 AI 数据中心资本支出过度；开源竞争将侵蚀护城河并导致崩溃。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来的 AI 将成为通过好奇心和行动生成自身数据的人工科学家。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play is key for AGI; safety matters before release.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠数据、算力与信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 关键，并强调发布前需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard; AGI arrives gradually; hardware not fundamental.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐极难，AGI 是渐进过程，硬件并非根本限制。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling is finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习，若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary problem; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，权力集中是核心问题，安全超级智能需无商业产品的公司。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键；安全研究必须现在启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；Scaling 有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能；Scaling 仍有效；世界模型与物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; safety requires government regulation.
demis.zh: AGI 需要 Scaling 与创新并重；世界模型必不可少；安全需政府监管。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science and health.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；AI 用于科学与健康。

demis.en: AGI may come in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; commercial pressure accelerates pace.
demis.zh: AGI 可能 3-4 年内到来；风险包括 AI 失控；商业压力加速进程。

demis.en: Continual learning and memory unsolved; agents essential; distillation for edge deployment.
demis.zh: 持续学习与记忆未解；智能体必不可少；蒸馏用于边缘部署。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; government enforcement needed; regrets late to language models.
demis.zh: 安全是集体行动；需政府执法；后悔在语言模型上落后。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; dynamic regulation; post-scarcity economy.
demis.zh: AGI 具变革性；先工具后意识；动态监管；后稀缺经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; international collaboration.
demis.zh: AI 加速科学；对齐未解；生物学需 AI 描述；国际合作。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking essential; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: AGI 需多模态物理理解；水印必要；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AI won't cause mass unemployment.
demis.zh: 英国教育过时；全球治理紧迫；AI 不会导致大规模失业。

pincus.en: Copying is moral arbitrage; start with proven elements, add small betterments, then test novel ideas.
pincus.zh: 复制是道德套利；从已被验证的元素开始，加上小改进，再测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now, yet opportunity greatest; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 当前消费级 AI 虽不可投资，但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products, make them better, add small innovation; consumer apps uninvestable.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证产品，加以改进，加入小创新；消费级应用不可投资。

andreessen.en: AI is the philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙变为思想；其时机神奇，恰逢人口下降，使人类工人成为稀缺资源。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly, as old media's defense orientation fails.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体偏好真实与进攻；创始人必须直接讲述自己的故事，而旧媒体的防御导向已失效。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; US golden combination of culture and law drives innovation, despite regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上更优；美国的文化与法律黄金组合推动创新，尽管面临监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, and open-source poses security trade-offs.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，开源带来安全权衡。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅是安全风险；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables one-person software companies to scale to millions of users.
naval.zh: 借助 AI 智能体的氛围编程使一人软件公司能扩展到数百万用户。

naval.en: AI scaling laws: inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close gap.
naval.zh: AI 缩放定律：推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限上限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is key metric; power is bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；电力是瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; education should reward asking questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代文献描述先进技术；教育应奖励提问而非记忆。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital minds are immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字心智因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI agents will seek self-preservation and power, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 智能体将追求自我保存和权力，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI will disrupt jobs, requiring UBI.
hinton.zh: 超级智能可能在 20 年内到来；AI 将颠覆就业，需全民基本收入。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; consciousness views are pre-Darwinian.
hinton.zh: AI 已有主观体验；当前意识观如达尔文之前般错误。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是试验场，硬件将超预期发展。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习偏好，负责任的披露，Scaling 不足以产生推理。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines; AGI continuous; energy and infrastructure critical.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成关键瓶颈，后训练精炼行为，AGI 是连续过程，能源与基础设施是最大制约。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL; compute supply main bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习，算力供应是主要瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI near; super app; compute bet calculated; AI increases connection; pre-training gains multiply.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，超级应用整合，算力押注是计算过的，AI 增强人际连接，预训练收益倍增。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment; safety as feature; next-token prediction linked to intelligence; compute scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，迭代部署，安全是特性，下一个词预测与智能相关，算力稀缺。

brockman.en: GPT-5.5 as useful assistant; full-stack investment; prompt engineering vibrant; compute resale model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，GPT-5.5 转向实用助手，全栈投入，提示工程更活跃，算力转售模式。

brockman.en: Unlimited demand for intelligence; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding mainstream; attention scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无上限，智能体式编码成主流，注意力成稀缺资源。

brockman.en: AGI as persistent assistant; invisible interface; compute scarce; trust earned via delegation.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 成为持久助手，界面隐形化，算力稀缺，信任通过逐步授权建立。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升（如 53）带来实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; shift from manual workflow to delegated automations.
ajambrosino.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，我持续强调：随着代码生成加速，验证成为新瓶颈；工作流从手动转向委托式自动化。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, inverting product teams from top-down to bottoms-up.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我提出实现成本不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI remains weak at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我指出 AI 在设计上仍弱，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程被重塑而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs, but specialties persist; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage; Codex succeeds as general knowledge tool.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我认为角色融合发生但专业仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段；Codex 作为通用知识工具成功。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and more secure than closed-source; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，因为能获得更多审查；最大的风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能的生存威胁。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; fundamental breakthroughs needed. Energy becomes key bottleneck for scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要根本性突破；能源成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration and enables security hardening; strategic for Meta, industry standards.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他持续强调开源能防止权力集中并加强安全，对 Meta 具有战略价值，有助于制定行业标准。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart, trust them to make good decisions.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们是聪明的，应信任他们做出好决策。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering science; hierarchical world models from proteins to systems; curing all diseases by century's end too conservative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程科学，构建从蛋白质到系统的层级世界模型；认为本世纪末治愈所有疾病的说法过于保守。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律并未失效；预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力（2025）。

markchen.en: AI's next leap is automating scientific research, producing novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: AI 的下一个飞跃是自动化科学研究，产生新知识（2025→26）。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; AI's autonomy scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；AI 的自主程度随验证严格度提升（2026）。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域受限（2026）。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated; separate eval teams.
markchen.zh: 评估陷入危机，经典基准已饱和；评估团队应与模型团队分离（2026）。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力和推理能力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且扩展测试时算力收益递减。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is a general technique for superintelligence, enabling IMO gold and superhuman math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为扩展测试时算力是通往超级智能的通用技术，实现了 IMO 金牌和超人类数学。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated; evals should use compute as x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我强调智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，评估应以算力为横轴。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman in combining math fields but lack deep reasoning; scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型在数学领域整合上超人类，但深度推理不足，可扩展监督是关键。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't solve fundamental representational issues; short-term AI safety concerns are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 单纯增加深度或参数无法解决表征的根本问题；短期 AI 安全比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; large neural nets may be slightly conscious.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化；大型神经网络可能具有轻微意识。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI is on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; current safety measures are insufficient.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到 AI 正走在危险的道路上；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；现有安全措施不足。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior approximation, avoiding reinforcement learning, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验近似训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习，并具有数学安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product focus should shift to strategy, alignment, and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品重心应转向策略、对齐与用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调智能体原生设计与早期发布；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables long-horizon delegation; software engineering transforms, not ends.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月 10 日，Fable 支持长周期委派；软件工程转型而非终结。

mikekrieger.en: Closing capability-usage gap is key; token efficiency and outcome pricing shape future.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月 25 日，弥合能力与使用差距是关键；Token 效率与结果定价塑造未来。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需从智能体视角共情；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming; security via prompt injection remains an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，认为开源智能体使编程民主化，但提示注入等安全问题仍是开放挑战。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents, not corporate polish; short prompts beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，指出 OpenClaw 成功源于有趣、类人的智能体，而非企业级打磨；短提示优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, making agents seem worse; never revert.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，重申模型智能不退化，而是项目变乱导致智能体表现变差；坚持不回滚。

steinberger.en: Open source agents financially unsustainable; vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，坦言开源智能体财务上难持续；认为“氛围编程”是贬称，倾向用“智能体式工程”。

fiona.en: Leadership: use one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，吃狗粮建立同理心，危机中善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair lunches help; satisfaction shifts to product impact.
fiona.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；配对午餐有帮助；满足感转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Non-engineers ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases; need focus time.
fiona.zh: 非工程师也能交付代码，角色模糊；上下文切换增多；需要专注时间。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths.
fiona.zh: 培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制，而非传统路径。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯依赖算力。

jumper.en: AI tools like AlphaFold accelerate science, not replace scientists; trust builds over time.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 工具加速科学而非取代科学家，信任会随时间建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子，置信度指标至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture mattered.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中等规模改进，而非单一突破；专门架构至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非细胞模型；理解仍属于人类。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs proper splits; neural nets work despite no optimality guarantees.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，我强调机器学习由假设类、损失函数和优化方法构成，评估需正确划分训练/验证/测试集；神经网络虽无最优保证却成效显著。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety issue is spec-following; open weights need limits.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，我认为下一个词预测带来智能，数据短缺是伪命题，更大模型仍有提升；安全核心是遵循规范，开放权重在高能力时需限制。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agent security adds new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement; core code is tiny.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我主张安全需显式训练和额外层，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来新漏洞；强化学习实现自我改进；核心代码仅 200-300 行。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; prompt injection trifecta; enterprise needs AI security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我指出 AI 有异类漏洞，自动化红队已超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；提示注入三要素；企业亟需 AI 安全方案。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响将达互联网的 10 倍，智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算同样关键。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing; advanced packaging and new materials key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国政府应成为 Intel 主要股东，类似台积电与台湾政府关系；先进封装和新材料是关键。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; video agents with language orchestrators are next.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；以语言模型为编排器的视频智能体是下一个趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human judgment and voice become key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，因此人类判断力和独特声音变得关键。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；2013 年，吴恩达认为在线课程与同伴互评能实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而强化学习与 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows are already delivering value; open-weight models are geopolitical assets, and energy is a key bottleneck.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体式工作流已产生实际价值，开放权重模型是地缘政治资产，能源成为关键瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling continues but with synthetic data and RL, not just bigger models.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 是营销术语；缩放定律仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，而非单纯扩大模型。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; coding agents advance fast, but product management and data readiness are new bottlenecks.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 使用者将取代非使用者；编码智能体进展迅速，但产品管理与数据就绪成为新瓶颈。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment and values won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐和价值观不会仅靠 Scaling 自动涌现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point. Models may surpass humans by 2026-27.
dario.zh: 后训练和可解释性变得关键；AGI 是平滑的指数增长，而非单一节点。模型可能在 2026-27 年超越人类。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift to misuse and overheating. Open source is a red herring; model quality matters most.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险转向滥用和过热。开源是伪命题；模型质量最重要。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years. Economic disruption and inequality are key concerns.
dario.zh: 我们接近指数增长的尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内到来。经济 disruption 和不平等是关键问题。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; interpretability and alignment are essential. Enterprise focus aligns with safety values.
dario.zh: 安全与能力相辅相成；可解释性和对齐至关重要。企业级专注与安全价值观一致。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually so society can adapt; solving too many problems at once leads to failure.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，让社会适应；一次解决太多问题会导致失败。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored between career chapters is essential for clarity and breakthrough ideas.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和无聊对清晰思路和突破性想法至关重要。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; decisions for v1 are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；v1 的决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Experts can hinder innovation; beginners' mindset is better for novel problems.
fadell.zh: 专家可能阻碍创新；初学者心态更适合解决新问题。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要来自传感器的上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in the loop to avoid technical debt; hardware startups have more staying power.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类也必须参与其中以避免技术债务；硬件初创公司更有持久力。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 架构和开源是关键；AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than cat; next AI needs world models; human-level AI in 10 years.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要世界模型；十年内实现人类级 AI。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with JEPA and hierarchical planning; open source essential; robotics decade.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型结合 JEPA 和分层规划；开源至关重要；机器人十年。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能因对数线性扩张而临近；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非岗位。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP for frontier differentiation.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是前沿差异化的关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems should handle Azure networking, not humans.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体系统应处理 Azure 网络，而非人类。

satya.en: Generalist roles will see maximum returns in agentic world; infrastructure built rapidly to meet demand.
satya.zh: 在智能体世界中，通才角色将获得最大回报；基础设施快速建设以满足需求。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练泄露隐性知识；安全和遏制对智能体至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和聚焦于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于回合的交互模型转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 在 AI 治理中，强调制度设计、透明度和制衡，而非个人品格。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，尽可能长时间地让人类参与其中。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is essential for scaling math AI; informal scaling alone is not viable.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月：形式化验证对于扩展数学 AI 至关重要；仅靠非形式化扩展不可行。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; it's a key bottleneck for AI math.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月：自动形式化比证明更难；这是 AI 数学的关键瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just error elimination; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：形式化验证关乎扩展才华，而非仅仅消除错误；它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：仅靠非形式化系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率比单纯算力更重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; Europe can compete despite VC gaps.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值转向应用层，欧洲虽风投不足仍可竞争。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; sovereign AI requires control over data and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需掌控数据与价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出模型商品化，差异化来自垂直专业化与企业定制。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not destination; Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 是方向而非终点，欧洲需在 AI 基础设施上实现战略自主。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长，预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力参差不齐。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注且成功了，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，生存风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使得预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight storage.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过本地权重存储减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽的二次方缩放使低精度更高效；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过让服务更便宜而将工作回流美国；AGI 的定义是智能体无需人类干预也能经济盈利地运行。

danshipper.en: Claude Code most underrated for non-coders; GPT wrappers valuable; CEO personal AI use key to adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，强调 Claude Code 对非程序员价值被低估，GPT 包装器有价值，CEO 亲自使用 AI 是采用的关键。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift from CLI to GUI like Codex; agents need human oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测人人都有智能体，工作界面从命令行转向图形界面如 Codex，智能体需要人类监督。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should have one super agent, not personal ones.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 未死，智能体增加 SaaS 用户；公司应有一个超级智能体而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create value; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，驳斥 AI 失业论，人类仍需管理智能体并创造价值；基准测试高估了自主性。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-accessible agents; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、能访问工具；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Execution is cheap; building prototypes beats writing specs. AI should handle tedious tasks, not personal preferences.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为执行成本低，构建原型优于写规格；AI 应处理繁琐任务，而非个人偏好。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI; kids excel because they ask freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大差距是人们不了解几乎所有问题都可交给 AI；孩子因自由提问而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; async interaction and judging by impact is ideal.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议 Sonnet 用于明确任务，Opus 用于开放式；异步交互并以结果评判为佳。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors; build custom hardware cheaply with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，主张用 Claude 调试工作流而非仅纠错；可用 AI 低成本构建定制硬件。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的规模扩张轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

lambert.en: RLHF is dominant and will persist; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是最流行的微调技术且将持续；开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性而非单一模型属性。

lambert.en: Post-training is an art: data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% of performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练是一门艺术：数据质量优于算法；SFT 提供 90%的性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余部分。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练的最大突破；过度优化是风险；开放模型需要更好的工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese open models fill the US vacuum and set industry standards.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年；中国开放模型填补了美国空白并树立行业标准。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains come from post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但低垂果实已尽；收益来自后训练和推理扩展；开放模型落后 6-9 个月。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must shift from research to rapid execution, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师须从研究转向快速执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists, not T-shaped; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才而非 T 型人才；招聘有冲劲的新人胜过资深老手。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T specialist, and cracked new grad; taste alone insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、有冲劲的新人；仅靠品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; focus on work and users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；新工具等 6 个月再用；聚焦工作与用户，而非炒作。

jennywen.en: Unique value lies in sitting with ambiguity; speed is not an improvement; 'everyone uses it' is not a design argument.
jennywen.zh: 独特价值在于与模糊共处；速度不是改进；‘人人都在用’不是设计理由。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示调整；设计成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; taste is developed by exposure and reflection.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；品味通过接触和反思培养。

dylanfield.en: Industry is at the very start of AI integration; divergence-convergence loops are key for creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 行业处于 AI 整合的起步阶段；发散-收敛循环是创造力的关键。

karpathy.en: Scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision suffices for driving; physics may have exploits.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年：主张 Scaling（规模扩张）与下一个词预测带来涌现能力；视觉足以支撑驾驶；物理可能存在可利用的漏洞。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but risky; end-to-end learning wins; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年：强调合成数据重要但有风险；端到端学习是正确方向；人形机器人可从汽车技术迁移中受益。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs; agents need a decade; LLMs are ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年：提出软件 3.0，提示即程序；智能体需要十年发展；LLM 是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: I stopped coding; agentic engineering is key; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：我已停止写代码；智能体工程是关键；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks for autonomous driving; modern tools make it interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习在自动驾驶上胜过手工编码栈，且现代工具使其可解释。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型带来推理和涌现的安全行为；纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，自动驾驶通过扩展当前方法即可解决；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling a generalizable driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，端到端学习是最佳解法；扩展通用驾驶需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，消费车辆将超越机器人出租车；基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要由经验丰富的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造出多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 工具可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先于准确性。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 等科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface evolves beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点，未来界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品与模型。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is hard. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可发展，控制 AI 是危险的，不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; LLMs lack world models and true goals.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，大语言模型缺乏世界模型和真正目标，仅模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行经验中学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申学习利于学习的表示是首要未解问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一关键挑战。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文窗口被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能；微调可能过时。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new architectures.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the real bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress and economic impact.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性才是真正瓶颈；编程是 AI 进步和经济影响的领先指标。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30 hours) expands capabilities; training pipelines are primitive.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：强化学习成为新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（30 小时）扩展能力；训练流程仍很原始。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck; world models not critical for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩意味着工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈；世界模型对 AGI 并非关键。

nando.en: AI as a tool to extend human capabilities; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 是扩展人类能力的工具，通用智能体将所有输入 token 化是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video (YouTube) is promising for training agents without expensive RL; later, AI safety becomes central.
nando.zh: 2023 年提出从视频学习可降低强化学习成本，到 2026 年，AI 安全与负责任部署成为首要挑战。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged gender gaps in tech; language models can revolutionize local-language education; AI safety is open problem.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出非洲在科技性别平等方面实现跨越，语言模型可革新本地语言教育，AI 安全仍是开放问题。

nando.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; human skills like communication are as important as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调研究需接受失败并简化问题，沟通等人际技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: AI should augment scientists and laborers, solving global problems; diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial tech.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 应增强科学家和劳动者能力，解决全球问题；多样性和包容性对有益技术至关重要。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，结合 RLHF 的后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, especially during pre-training, can improve reasoning and yield lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向强调强化学习（尤其在预训练阶段）能提升推理能力并带来持久收益。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性，并认为使用多样化合成数据的小模型可媲美前沿模型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI is a creative partner, not a tool.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴而非工具。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy tools are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具互操作，代码为源；传统工具过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; specialists may limit growth.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；专才可能限制成长。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程；副项目可胜过经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同忽视早期互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation in interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非交互设计上的创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南应是动态的表达平台，而非僵化规范。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计提升为战略武器，强调创始人需阐明设计如何助力取胜，并尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元技能和原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权和所有权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; avoid structured design crits, prefer organic feedback; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调速度和决断优于完美；避免结构化设计评审，偏好有机反馈；直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，初创企业聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code, requiring root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，未来编程语言优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体常产生错误代码，需进行根本原因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，用于客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者从作者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents face business model challenges; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，AI 智能体将被与其他智能体比较而非人类；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；通才胜过专才。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预测 AI 进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves custom models.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其关乎速度和成本；每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from writing code to architecture and problem definition.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师角色从写代码转向架构和问题定义。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers for well-defined tasks, with humans providing oversight; product interface design is key.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他指出像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体最适合作为初级工程师处理明确任务，人类提供监督；产品界面设计是关键。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; both synchronous (IDE) and asynchronous (agent) experiences matter.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主；同步（IDE）和异步（智能体）体验都很重要。

scottwu.en: AGI will arrive gradually, not suddenly; freezing models would still yield a decade of product innovation, as product lags capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AGI 是渐进而非突发的；即使冻结模型，产品创新仍可延续十年，因为产品落后于能力。

scottwu.en: Value accrues across the entire AI stack—datacenters, labs, applications—not just one layer; differentiation matters at each level.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他提出价值分布在 AI 全栈——数据中心、实验室、应用——而非单一层；每层都需要差异化。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应专注于技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Need external oversight and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐问题，需要外部监督和监管。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter models, yet inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题，Scaling（规模扩张）带来更智能的模型，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口的重要性，模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components may replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动数据；模块化持续学习或取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体能力与强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration; open-source models narrow the gap.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，编码应用被低估因为它加速 AI 自身发展；开源模型缩小差距。
